{{Quote|Get me Admiral Wurtz. I need three of his star cruisers.|Jedi Master Mace Windu to a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]]|audio=GetMeAdmiralWurtz-CloneWars.flac|<ref name="TCWfilm" />}}
'''Wurtz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCWfilm" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] tried to contact Wurtz from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to ask for three of the admiral's [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]].<ref name="TCWfilm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wurtz was first mentioned in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], and the spelling of his name was revealed in the subtitles for the DVD version.<ref name="TCWfilm" />
